summary: First full iteration: backend 49/49 pytest cases pass; frontend 24/24 UI flows pass across all 14 routes. All KPI cards, India map, navigation, inventory pagination + filters + view dialog, demand forecast horizons, early-warnings, resource allocation approve dialog (POST /api/resource-transfer), PHC network → PHC detail, federated training round (POST /api/federated-training), emergency mode activate/deactivate (POST /api/emergency-mode), analytics range switch, reports generation, settings reset dialog, and top-bar notifications + global search all working. Backend internal consistency (days_remaining ≈ stock/daily_consumption, risk bands) verified.

issues: When notifications panel opens it overlaps the KPI card row (patient footfall gets partially hidden) — z-index/spacing OK but visually crowded on 1920 width.

console_warnings.note: Non-blocking. Likely in a list render (possibly notifications, top-risk-states, or a chart). Recommend main agent audit .map() key props across pages/components.
One 404 in network tab — likely favicon/manifest asset, not an API. Verify /public assets.

action_items: (LOW) Fix React duplicate-key warning in list renders — inspect .map() usages, especially in Notifications, TopRiskStates, and any chart component using non-unique ids.
(LOW) Investigate the single 404 resource request (likely favicon/manifest) for cleanliness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1100 lines and holds all routes, helpers, and models — should be split into routers/services modules for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

enrich_lines() is invoked multiple times per request in some endpoints (e.g. /alerts calls it twice, once filtered + once for counts, over ~thousands of lines); consider memoizing per-request or computing counts in one pass.

In-memory DATA cache is populated on startup and mutated on writes (resource-transfer, federated-training). If multiple gunicorn/uvicorn workers were used, the cache would diverge from Mongo. Currently OK with single worker, but noteworthy.

random.Random(...) is used inside GET endpoints (dashboard sparklines, phc_detail series, analytics ts, inventory/charts) with seeds sometimes derived from constants — outputs are stable, but pattern is a bit unusual; fine for the simulated/deterministic use case.
CORS allow_origins reads env split by ',' but middleware is added AFTER include_router — order works in FastAPI, still recommend adding middleware before include_router for clarity.
seed_data_creation: None — used built-in synthetic dataset. Called POST /api/reset at end of backend tests to leave DB clean. Emergency and simulations also deactivated/cleared during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses pytest-xdist, runs in <15s). It calls POST /api/reset last, so DB is clean after run. Emergency and simulation flows both activate then deactivate/clear so no leftover state. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. All data-testids listed in review_request are present and working.
